figures.caption_in_manuscript: Fig. 1. Overall pipeline of the unified single- and multi-modal fire and smoke dataset construction: (1) data sources, (2) data curation and deduplication, (3) sensor calibration and optical–thermal image registration, (4) semi-supervised annotation and expert review, and (5) released datasets.

Fig. 2. Measurement configuration and data acquisition environments: (a) hardware configuration, (b) real-world experimental setup, and (c) virtual environments for synthetic optical–thermal data generation.

Fig. 3. Flowchart of dataset curation and deduplication: (a) overall curation pipeline for single-modal optical and multi-modal optical–thermal datasets, and (b) four-stage deduplication algorithm comprising.
Fig. 4. Optical–thermal image registration based on sensor calibration: (a) intrinsic calibration, (b) extrinsic calibration, and (c) optical–thermal image registration.
Fig. 5. Semi-supervised data annotation and expert review: (a) initial annotation, (b) auto-labeling through semi-supervised object detector, and (c) expert review.
Fig. 6. Data structures of the (a) unified single-modal optical dataset and (b) multi-modal optical–thermal dataset.

Fig. 7. Representative images and bounding-box annotations in UniFSD: (a) unified single-modal optical dataset and (b) paired multi-modal optical–thermal dataset comprising real-world and synthetic image pairs.

Fig. 8. Distributions of normalized bounding-box dimensions in UniFSD: single-modal optical dataset annotations of (a) fire and (b) smoke, and multi-modal optical–thermal dataset annotations of (c) fire and (d) smoke.

Fig. 9. Calibration-target feature detection and optical–thermal registration results: (a) optical–LiDAR calibration, (b) thermal–LiDAR calibration, (c) marker–corner correspondence comparison, and (d) optical–thermal registration overlay.
Fig. 10. Qualitative detection results on UniFSD: (a) single-modal optical dataset and (b) multi-modal optical–thermal dataset with real-world and synthetic image pairs.
